mentions.title: McLaren 'seemed to gain performance' with upgrades – Norris
mentions.summary: Lando Norris believes that McLaren "seemed to gain performance" during Friday practice ahead of the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, with the team having brought several upgrades this weekend.

mentions.title: McLaren to bring upgrades to Brazil GP with F1 2027 in mind
mentions.summary:
McLaren will introduce upgrades to its MCL40 Formula 1 car at this weekend’s Brazil Grand Prix, featuring a front wing concept which is expected to feature on its 2027 challenger.
The team had surged to the front when it substantially updated the MCL40 in Hungary, with Lando Norris winning that race and the following one at Zandvoort, but it has since slipped back in the pecking order despite ...Keep reading

mentions.title: McLaren’s upgrade is "a pleasant surprise" – but will it stay on the car in Brazil?
mentions.summary:
After one of the most turbulent world championship defences since Jenson Button in 2010, Lando Norris gave McLaren’s latest batch of car upgrades a cautious thumbs-up on the Friday of the Sao Paulo GP. Norris topped the first practice session, edging out Mercedes’ Kimi Antonelli by 0.082s, and was among the quickest in terms of average pace on his long runs through FP2.

mentions.title: "Unacceptable downshifts" – Max Verstappen explains what's behind a recurring F1 radio complaint
mentions.summary:
Verstappen finished the opening practice session of the Formula 1 weekend in Sao Paulo in third place, just over two tenths behind fastest man Lando Norris in the upgraded McLaren, which features a new front wing that serves as the baseline for 2027.

mentions.title: Williams has not upgraded 2026 car to “save the cost cap dollars for next year” – Vowles | Formula 1
mentions.summary: Williams team principal James Vowles says the decision not to bring further upgrades for its car was "horribly painful".
